tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a product, how-to, security or integration question about Tallyfy by pointing to the most relevant official product documentation. Use for specific product questions; use the other tools for pricing, templates, comparisons, compliance or starting a trial.

tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Book a live Tallyfy demo/call. Pre-fills the visitor's name, email and topic on the scheduling page; the visitor picks a time themselves (no auto-booking). Returns the booking link.

name.description: The visitor's name (optional, pre-fills the form).

email.description: The visitor's email (optional, pre-fills the form).

topic.description: What they want to discuss (optional, pre-fills the form).

tools.name: calculate_roi
tools.description: Estimate what manual, repetitive busywork costs a company per week, per year and over five years. Provide the number of employees, the hours per person per week lost to busywork, and average hourly pay; returns the cost plus a link to start automating with Tallyfy.

hours_per_week.description: Hours per person per week lost to busywork.

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Report Tallyfy's compliance and security posture for a given standard (SOC 2 Type II, GDPR / EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, accessibility / VPAT, PCI). Returns an accurate status and a link, including honest detail about what Tallyfy does and does not hold.

standard.description: The standard to check, e.g. "SOC 2" or "HIPAA". Optional.

tools.name: check_integration
tools.description: Check whether Tallyfy integrates with a specific tool (e.g. Zapier, Power Automate, Microsoft Teams, Slack, n8n) or via its REST API, webhooks or MCP server. Returns the integration status and a documentation link.

tool.description: The tool to check, e.g. "Power Automate".

tools.name: compare_tallyfy
tools.description: Compare Tallyfy side-by-side against another workflow, project-management or BPM tool - Asana, Monday, ClickUp, Notion, Process Street and 70+ others. Returns the key feature differences plus links to explore Tallyfy as an alternative or to book a call.

competitor.description: The tool to compare against, e.g. "Asana". Optional on a competitor comparison page.

tools.name: explain_pricing
tools.description: Explain how Tallyfy pricing works - the per-seat model with Full and Light members, free unlimited guests, and what is included free (SSO, support, migration) - and link to current rates. Does not quote specific dollar amounts because pricing can change.

tools.name: find_template
tools.description: Search Tallyfy's library of ready-made workflow templates by keyword (e.g. 'client onboarding', 'approval', 'employee onboarding'). Returns matching templates with a short summary, the template page, and a link to start a free Tallyfy trial pre-loaded with that template.

query.description: What the workflow is about, e.g. "client onboarding" or "approval".

tools.name: generate_process
tools.description: Turn a plain-English description of any business process into a structured, step-by-step procedure (roles, deadlines, automation ideas) using Tallyfy's free AI SOP generator. Returns a link that runs the generator automatically and produces a downloadable Word document.

description.description: Plain-English description of the process to document (at least 10 characters).

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Return a real Tallyfy customer testimonial or case study, optionally matched to an industry or use case. Returns the quote, who said it, and a link to read more.

industry.description: Industry or use case to match (optional).

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search tallyfy.com's own pages: blog articles, solution pages and vendor comparisons. Use this for opinions, guides, industry topics and 'does Tallyfy have a page about X' questions. It does NOT cover the product documentation, which answer_question handles.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "employee onboarding", "AI in operations" or a vendor name.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Start a free 14-day Tallyfy trial. Returns a signup link, optionally pre-loaded with a specific template or use case. No credit card required.

use_case.description: What the user wants Tallyfy for (optional).

template_id.description: A Tallyfy template id to pre-load (optional).
